scenes.heading: SAME AI. SAME BRIEF. WATCH THE DESIGN CHANGE.
scenes.sub: impeccable · design vocabulary for coding agents
scenes.say: Why does AI-built design so often look the same?

scenes.heading: impeccable
scenes.sub: a design vocabulary for your coding agent
scenes.say: It's called impeccable. It gives your coding agent a design vocabulary, so you steer it with words like polish and bolder.

scenes.heading: TWO COMMANDS
scenes.say: From your project root, run npx impeccable install. Then run the init command in your agent, and reload your coding tool.

scenes.heading: WITHOUT, THEN WITH
scenes.say: The repo shows the same model and brief twice. Without impeccable, the page is a cream layout with pill buttons. With it, the page is built around one picture.

scenes.heading: WHAT TO KNOW
scenes.say: The catch: you review the result with critique and audit, so you still decide what looks right.
Which page would you fix first? Comment POLISH and I'll pin the link.
